name: Ehrwalder Alm
kurzbeschreibung: The vast **Ehrwalder Alm** high plateau offers a unique view of the **Zugspitze** and countless hiking trails for every level.
beschreibung: Ehrwalder Alm – Nestled in the stunning Tiroler landscape, the Ehrwalder Alm is a true gem of the Außerfern region. This expansive alpine plateau offers breathtaking views of the Zugspitze and a variety of hiking trails for all skill levels. The perfect blend of natural beauty, Tiroler hospitality, and easy accessibility makes the Ehrwalder Alm an ideal destination for a day trip, whether you're visiting solo, as a couple, or with your whole family. Located in Ehrwald within the Außerfern region, the Alm is well-signposted, with free parking and proximity to other attractions ensuring a convenient visit. A must-visit for any Tirol traveler, the Ehrwalder Alm promises unforgettable experiences.
